.name: Batch add to Steam collections
.note: Add games to existing writable collections. Supply appIds plus collectionIds or one exact collectionName, or use changes for per-game targets.
.parameters.changes: Alternatively, supply the game AppID and a list of collection IDs for each game.
.description: Add games to existing writable collections. Supply appIds plus collectionIds or one exact collectionName, or use changes for per-game targets.
.error.badCollection: Add games to existing writable collections. Supply appIds plus collectionIds or one exact collectionName, or use changes for per-game targets.
.error.noCollection: No unique writable collection matched. Check the collection ID.
.parameters.collectionName: Exact writable collection name. It must match one collection.
